ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Infinite Potential
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: A reminder of wholeness and the cyclical nature of experience. In contemporary spiritual practice, 000 is often interpreted as a prompt to reflect on new beginnings and the completion of a cycle. Noticing repeating numbers is a normal feature of human pattern recognition; the meaning you assign is personal and reflective.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Alignment & Intention
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: Often interpreted in modern spiritual communities as a prompt to pay attention to your thoughts and intentions. The idea that repeating 1s signal a "manifestation portal" is a contemporary practice, not a documented ancient tradition. Use it as a journaling cue if it resonates.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Balance & Partnership
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: Associated in contemporary numerology with themes of cooperation, patience, and trust in a process. If you notice 222 frequently, it can serve as a gentle reminder to check in on your relationships and your own sense of balance.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Creative Expression
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: Linked in modern practice to creativity, self-expression, and the encouragement to share your voice. Some traditions associate it with spiritual support; others see it simply as a prompt to engage with creative work.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Grounding & Stability
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: Often interpreted as a reminder to build solid foundations and to trust the work you are doing. In contemporary angel-number practice, 444 is associated with stability and perseverance.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Change & Transition
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: Associated with significant change and the invitation to embrace transformation. If 555 appears during a period of transition, some find it useful as a prompt to reflect on what they are releasing and what they are moving toward.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Reflection & Rebalancing
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: In modern angel-number practice (distinct from its use in other religious contexts), 666 is often reframed as a prompt to rebalance — to check whether material concerns are overshadowing other areas of life. Interpretations vary widely.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Inner Wisdom
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: Associated in contemporary practice with spiritual inquiry, inner wisdom, and a deepening of self-knowledge. Some see it as encouragement to trust your intuition and continue learning.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Abundance & Flow
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: Linked in modern numerology to themes of abundance, reciprocity, and the flow of energy. The figure-eight shape of 8 is sometimes cited as a symbol of infinite exchange.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Completion & Release
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: Associated with endings, completion, and the clearing of what no longer serves. In contemporary practice, 999 is often seen as a prompt to reflect on what cycle is closing and what new one is beginning.

ANGEL_NUMBERS.title: Awakening & Presence
ANGEL_NUMBERS.body: One of the most widely noted repeating-number patterns in contemporary spiritual culture. Often interpreted as a prompt to be present and intentional. The practice of making a wish at 11:11 is a modern folk tradition with no documented ancient origin.
